scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: To move past another vehicle, bicyclist or other road user travelling in the same direction, usually by moving into another lane or part of the road and then returning.
A person driving a motor vehicle on the road.
A person riding a bicycle, who has the same rights and responsibilities as other drivers.
On a multilane road, the far left lane, closest to the center divider, used to pass other vehicles.
A single solid yellow line marking the center of a road with two-way traffic.
A pair of solid yellow lines painted on the road surface that drivers must not pass over.
A broken yellow line marking that indicates passing is allowed when it is next to the driver's lane.
A pair of solid white lines forming a lane barrier, such as between a regular lane and a preferential (carpool/HOV) lane, or in or near freeway on and off ramps.
A lane in the middle of a two-way street, marked on both sides by a broken inner line and a solid outer line, used to prepare for and make a left turn or U-turn.
A special turnout area or lane on some two-lane roads into which slower vehicles merge to let vehicles behind them pass.
An intersection where traffic travels in one direction around a central island.
The part of the road set aside for pedestrians to safely cross the road, marked or unmarked.
A space set aside for pedestrians waiting for buses, streetcars, and trolleys, marked by raised buttons or markers on the road.
A maneuver in which a law enforcement officer turns on emergency lights and slowly weaves across lanes to slow or stop traffic.
A large vehicle or truck, such as a commercial truck, that takes longer to stop and is harder to maneuver than a passenger vehicle.

rules.title: Judge space when approaching hazards
rules.when: approaching an oncoming vehicle or BICYCLIST OR a hill, curve, intersection, or road obstruction
rules.action: judge whether there is enough space to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching an oncoming vehicle or BICYCLIST OR a hill, curve, intersection, or road obstruction, the DRIVER MUST judge whether there is enough space to PASS.

rules.title: Hill or curve one-third mile ahead
rules.when: intending to PASS AND a hill or curve is ahead
rules.action: PASS only if the hill or curve is at least one-third of a mile ahead
rules.statement: WHEN intending to PASS AND a hill or curve is ahead, the PASSER SHOULD PASS only if the hill or curve is at least one-third of a mile ahead.

rules.title: Look ahead before passing
rules.when: before starting to PASS
rules.action: look ahead for road conditions that may cause other vehicles to move into the PASSER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN before starting to PASS, the PASSER MUST look ahead for road conditions that may cause other vehicles to move into the PASSER's lane.

vague_terms.term: road conditions that may cause other vehicles to move into the PASSER's lane

rules.title: Use the left lane to pass
rules.when: intending to PASS on a road with more than one lane in the PASSER's direction
rules.action: use the left lane to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN intending to PASS on a road with more than one lane in the PASSER's direction, the PASSER SHOULD use the left lane to PASS.
rules.note: Given as a tip for choosing a lane; 10.46 describes the far left lane as the PASSING LANE.

rules.title: Never leave the pavement to pass
rules.when: passing
rules.action: drive off the paved or main-traveled part of the road to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN passing, the PASSER MUST NOT drive off the paved or main-traveled part of the road to PASS.

rules.title: Avoid passing in heavy fog or smoke
rules.when: driving in heavy fog or smoke
rules.action: cross lanes or PASS traffic
rules.statement: WHEN driving in heavy fog or smoke, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT cross lanes or PASS traffic, UNLESS absolutely necessary.

rules.title: Pass carefully at emergency flashers
rules.when: a vehicle's emergency flashers are seen ahead
rules.action: slow down and PASS carefully
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle's emergency flashers are seen ahead, the DRIVER MUST slow down and PASS carefully.
rules.note: Reason given: there may be a collision or other road emergency.

rules.title: No passing in a roundabout
rules.when: travelling in a ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: stop or PASS
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in a ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop or PASS.

rules.title: Do not pass the patrol vehicle in a traffic break
rules.when: a law enforcement officer is conducting a TRAFFIC BREAK ahead
rules.action: drive past the patrol vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a law enforcement officer is conducting a TRAFFIC BREAK ahead, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT drive past the patrol vehicle.
rules.note: Introduced by 'You should'; the same item says not to speed up until the officer turns off the emergency lights and traffic conditions allow.

rules.title: Single solid yellow line on your side
rules.when: there is only one lane of traffic going in the DRIVER's direction AND a SINGLE SOLID YELLOW LINE is on the DRIVER's side of the road
rules.action: PASS a vehicle in front
rules.statement: WHEN there is only one lane of traffic going in the DRIVER's direction AND a SINGLE SOLID YELLOW LINE is on the DRIVER's side of the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS a vehicle in front.

rules.title: Do not pass over double solid yellow lines
rules.when: passing AND DOUBLE SOLID YELLOW LINES mark the road
rules.action: pass over the DOUBLE SOLID YELLOW LINES
rules.statement: WHEN passing AND DOUBLE SOLID YELLOW LINES mark the road, the PASSER MUST NOT pass over the DOUBLE SOLID YELLOW LINES.
rules.note: The handbook's exceptions (HOV lane entrance on the left, signs directing traffic to the other side, left turns into driveways or U-turns) concern crossing for other purposes, not overtaking.

rules.title: Broken yellow line: passing allowed when safe
rules.when: a BROKEN YELLOW LINE is next to the PASSER's driving lane AND it is safe
rules.action: PASS
rules.statement: WHEN a BROKEN YELLOW LINE is next to the PASSER's driving lane AND it is safe, the PASSER MAY PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.note: Block says 'Only pass when it is safe'.

rules.title: No passing across double solid white lines
rules.when: passing AND DOUBLE SOLID WHITE LINES separate the lanes
rules.action: change lanes over the DOUBLE SOLID WHITE LINES
rules.statement: WHEN passing AND DOUBLE SOLID WHITE LINES separate the lanes, the PASSER MUST NOT change lanes over the DOUBLE SOLID WHITE LINES.
rules.note: Stated as a general lane-change rule ('Never change lanes over double solid white lines. Wait until you see a single broken white line'); applied here to the lane change made when passing.

rules.title: Center left turn lane is not a passing lane
rules.when: a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE is present
rules.action: use the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE is present, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to PASS.
rules.note: Handbook says the lane 'is not a regular traffic lane or passing lane' and limits driving in it to 200 feet; the prohibition is inferred from that wording.

rules.title: No passing at a blind hill or curve
rules.when: approaching a hill or curve AND the DRIVER cannot see if other traffic is approaching
rules.action: PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a hill or curve AND the DRIVER cannot see if other traffic is approaching, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS.
rules.note: Handbook adds that this is very dangerous on one and two lane roads.

rules.title: No passing within 100 feet of hazards
rules.when: within 100 feet of an intersection, bridge, tunnel, railroad crossing, or other hazardous area
rules.action: PASS
rules.statement: WHEN within 100 feet of an intersection, bridge, tunnel, railroad crossing, or other hazardous area, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS.

rules.title: No passing at crossroads and driveways
rules.when: at crossroads or driveways
rules.action: PASS
rules.statement: WHEN at crossroads or driveways, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS.

rules.title: Pass only with space to return
rules.when: considering a PASS
rules.action: PASS
rules.unless: there is enough space to return to the DRIVER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN considering a PASS, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS, UNLESS there is enough space to return to the DRIVER's lane.

rules.title: No passing a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: PASS the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: Reason given: the driver may not be able to see a pedestrian crossing the street.

rules.title: How to pass on an open highway
rules.when: going to PASS on an open highway
rules.action: signal the plan to PASS, look over the shoulder to check blind spots, drive into the PASSING LANE, speed up to PASS the vehicle, then signal and return to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN going to PASS on an open highway, the PASSER MUST signal the plan to PASS, look over the shoulder to check blind spots, drive into the PASSING LANE, speed up to PASS the vehicle, then signal and return to the original lane.
rules.note: Steps given as a list of plain commands.

rules.title: Check a large vehicle's signals before passing
rules.when: following a LARGE VEHICLE AND before starting to PASS it
rules.action: look at the LARGE VEHICLE's turn signals
rules.statement: WHEN following a LARGE VEHICLE AND before starting to PASS it, the DRIVER MUST look at the LARGE VEHICLE's turn signals.
rules.note: Reason given: it may appear to be turning one way but be swinging wide the other way to turn.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: an open highway has two or more lanes going in the PASSER's direction OR the driver ahead is turning left and the PASSER can safely PASS on the right OR the PASSER is on a one-way street
rules.action: PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN an open highway has two or more lanes going in the PASSER's direction OR the driver ahead is turning left and the PASSER can safely PASS on the right OR the PASSER is on a one-way street, the PASSER MAY ONLY PASS on the right.
rules.note: MAY ONLY: passing on the right is allowed only in these cases.

rules.title: Never pass on the left of a left-turning driver
rules.when: the driver ahead is signaling a left turn
rules.action: PASS on the left
rules.statement: WHEN the driver ahead is signaling a left turn, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS on the left.

rules.title: Pass large vehicles on the left
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: PASS on the left side of the LARGE VEHICLE
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST PASS on the left side of the LARGE VEHICLE.

rules.title: No passing light rail or streetcars on the left
rules.when: a light rail vehicle or streetcar is ahead, whether moving or standing
rules.action: overtake and PASS it on the left side
rules.unless: the tracks are so close to the right side that the vehicle cannot PASS on the right OR the DRIVER is on a one-way street OR a traffic officer directs the DRIVER to PASS on the left
rules.statement: WHEN a light rail vehicle or streetcar is ahead, whether moving or standing, the DRIVER MUST NOT overtake and PASS it on the left side, UNLESS the tracks are so close to the right side that the vehicle cannot PASS on the right OR the DRIVER is on a one-way street OR a traffic officer directs the DRIVER to PASS on the left.

rules.title: Bus, streetcar, trolley stopped: 10 mph
rules.when: a bus, streetcar, or trolley is stopped at a SAFETY ZONE or traffic light
rules.action: PASS at no more than 10 mph
rules.statement: WHEN a bus, streetcar, or trolley is stopped at a SAFETY ZONE or traffic light, the DRIVER MAY PASS at no more than 10 mph.
rules.note: Read as permitting the pass only at 10 mph or less.

rules.title: Never drive through a safety zone
rules.when: passing a bus, streetcar, or trolley OR otherwise driving near a SAFETY ZONE
rules.action: drive through the SAFETY ZONE
rules.statement: WHEN passing a bus, streetcar, or trolley OR otherwise driving near a SAFETY ZONE, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive through the SAFETY ZONE.
rules.note: Handbook: 'Do not drive through a safety zone under any condition.'

rules.title: Move ahead after passing a large vehicle
rules.when: driving near a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: drive next to it longer than needed, and after passing it the DRIVER must move ahead of it
rules.statement: WHEN driving near a LARGE VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive next to it longer than needed, and after passing it the DRIVER must move ahead of it.
rules.note: Reason given: driving alongside makes it hard for the large vehicle's driver to avoid dangers.

rules.title: Do not cut in front of a large vehicle and brake
rules.when: moving in front of a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: suddenly slow down or stop
rules.statement: WHEN moving in front of a LARGE VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST NOT suddenly slow down or stop.
rules.note: Reason given: the large vehicle cannot stop fast enough. 13.13 also says not to change lanes directly in front of large vehicles to reach an exit or turn.

rules.title: Never pass a motorcycle in the same lane
rules.when: a motorcycle is ahead in the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: try to PASS the motorcycle in the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN a motorcycle is ahead in the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT try to PASS the motorcycle in the same lane.
rules.note: 13.38 says lane splitting (sharing lanes with motorcycles) is legal and advises giving a motorcycle the full lane whenever possible.

rules.title: Follow a slow bicyclist at a safe distance
rules.when: behind a BICYCLIST travelling slower than the flow of traffic in the travel lane
rules.action: follow at a safe distance
rules.statement: WHEN behind a BICYCLIST travelling slower than the flow of traffic in the travel lane, the DRIVER SHOULD follow at a safe distance.

rules.title: Passing a bicyclist by changing lanes
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST in the travel lane by changing to another lane
rules.action: PASS safely, leave space between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST, then return to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST in the travel lane by changing to another lane, the PASSER MUST PASS safely, leave space between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST, then return to the original lane.
rules.note: Block 13.110 says the driver 'may need to change to another lane' to pass safely.

rules.title: Three feet when passing a bicyclist
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST AND the PASSER cannot change lanes
rules.action: PASS the BICYCLIST
rules.unless: at least three feet of clearance between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST can be given
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST AND the PASSER cannot change lanes, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS the BICYCLIST, UNLESS at least three feet of clearance between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST can be given.
rules.note: 13.115 words this as plain commands; 10.71 (a caption for a missing image) says three feet 'must be maintained', so the stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: Do not force bicyclists into parked cars or doors
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST
rules.action: give the BICYCLIST enough space so they are not forced into parked vehicles or open vehicle doors
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST, the PASSER MUST give the BICYCLIST enough space so they are not forced into parked vehicles or open vehicle doors.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given beyond the three-foot rule

rules.title: Care passing bicyclists on two-lane roads
rules.when: approaching or passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road
rules.action: be careful
rules.statement: WHEN approaching or passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road, the DRIVER SHOULD be careful.

rules.title: Oncoming vehicle and bicyclist: one at a time
rules.when: on a two-lane road with an oncoming vehicle to the left AND a BICYCLIST ahead to the right
rules.action: slow down and let the oncoming vehicle pass, then move to the left to allow at least three feet to PASS the BICYCLIST, instead of driving between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane road with an oncoming vehicle to the left AND a BICYCLIST ahead to the right, the DRIVER MUST slow down and let the oncoming vehicle pass, then move to the left to allow at least three feet to PASS the BICYCLIST, instead of driving between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST.
rules.note: Given as an example of taking one danger at a time and giving more space to the greater danger.

rules.title: Steady oncoming flow when passing a bicyclist
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road AND there is a steady flow of oncoming vehicles
rules.action: use as much of the left lane as the PASSER safely can
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road AND there is a steady flow of oncoming vehicles, the PASSER MUST use as much of the left lane as the PASSER safely can.

rules.title: Bicyclist may leave the right edge to pass
rules.when: travelling slower than the flow of traffic
rules.action: ride as close as possible to the right curb or edge of the road
rules.unless: passing a vehicle or another bicycle in the same direction OR preparing to make a left turn OR avoiding a hazard or road condition OR the lane is too narrow for a bicycle and a vehicle to safely travel side-by-side OR approaching a right turn OR on a one-way road with two or more lanes
rules.statement: WHEN travelling slower than the flow of traffic, the BICYCLIST MUST ride as close as possible to the right curb or edge of the road, UNLESS passing a vehicle or another bicycle in the same direction OR preparing to make a left turn OR avoiding a hazard or road condition OR the lane is too narrow for a bicycle and a vehicle to safely travel side-by-side OR approaching a right turn OR on a one-way road with two or more lanes.
rules.note: Included for its passing exception; on a one-way road with two or more lanes the bicyclist may ride near the left curb or edge.

rules.title: Move over and slow down for stopped emergency and work vehicles
rules.when: approaching a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing emergency signal lights OR a stationary tow truck displaying flashing amber warning lights OR a stopped road work vehicle displaying emergency flashing or amber warning lights
rules.action: move over and slow down
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing emergency signal lights OR a stationary tow truck displaying flashing amber warning lights OR a stopped road work vehicle displaying emergency flashing or amber warning lights, the DRIVER MUST move over and slow down.
rules.note: 13.47 words it as a command; 13.136 says drivers 'must', recorded as the stronger wording.

rules.title: Allow a vehicle to pass
rules.when: a vehicle is passing the DRIVER OR signals that it plans to PASS
rules.action: allow the vehicle to PASS and maintain lane position and speed
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is passing the DRIVER OR signals that it plans to PASS, the DRIVER MUST allow the vehicle to PASS and maintain lane position and speed.

rules.title: Use turnouts to let vehicles pass
rules.when: on a two-lane road with a TURNOUT AND vehicles are behind the DRIVER
rules.action: merge into the TURNOUT to allow the vehicles behind to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane road with a TURNOUT AND vehicles are behind the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST merge into the TURNOUT to allow the vehicles behind to PASS.
rules.note: Stated as a plain command; 10.67 gives the stricter legal requirement (PASS-BEING-03).

rules.title: Turnout required with five following vehicles
rules.when: driving slowly on a two-lane road where passing is unsafe AND five or more vehicles are following the DRIVER AND a TURNOUT is available
rules.action: use the TURNOUT to let the other vehicles PASS
rules.statement: WHEN driving slowly on a two-lane road where passing is unsafe AND five or more vehicles are following the DRIVER AND a TURNOUT is available, the DRIVER MUST use the TURNOUT to let the other vehicles PASS.

rules.title: Move right for faster drivers
rules.when: another driver is close behind AND wishes to drive faster
rules.action: move to the right
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is close behind AND wishes to drive faster, the DRIVER MUST move to the right.
rules.note: Same block says drivers choosing to drive slower than other traffic should use the right lane.

rules.title: Let a tailgater pass
rules.when: a tailgater is behind the DRIVER
rules.action: create more space in front, maintain course and speed, and then merge right to change into another lane and allow the tailgater to PASS when safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN a tailgater is behind the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST create more space in front, maintain course and speed, and then merge right to change into another lane and allow the tailgater to PASS when safe to do so.

rules.title: Give motorcyclists room to pass
rules.when: a motorcyclist is passing AND it is possible
rules.action: move to one side of the DRIVER's lane to give the motorcyclist more room to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN a motorcyclist is passing AND it is possible, the DRIVER MUST move to one side of the DRIVER's lane to give the motorcyclist more room to PASS.

rules.title: Bicyclist moves to let vehicles pass
rules.when: riding in a travel lane slower than traffic AND it is safe
rules.action: move to a position that allows vehicles to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN riding in a travel lane slower than traffic AND it is safe, the BICYCLIST SHOULD move to a position that allows vehicles to PASS.
